noticias.titulo: Is a 'SaaSpocalypse'-like sell-off coming for AI hardware stocks? Not so fast - CNBC
noticias.resumo: On Monday, at least, we're back in a market where Anthropic talks, and we all freak out.  The selling pressure hitting AI infrastructure stocks on Monday feels reminiscent of sell-offs in software stocks earlier this year, when investors feared that technological advances from Anthropic (and others) would disrupt their lucrative business models.  Now, the infrastructure stocks — chipmakers and all manner of data-center suppliers, including gas turbine makers and electrical equipment vendors — are tumbling on concerns that demand for their products will weaken in a world where AI model development is intentionally throttled back, as Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called for this weekend due to safety concerns.
